profile.headline: Developer at RecruitMilitary
profile.summary: Always up for a challenge, I'm on the next big adventure- software development. My curiosity and need to learn has brought me from Colorado, to Bolivia, to Japan and back again. I love to communicate with and learn from everyone I can- studying Spanish and Japanese while working in English education abroad helped me do just that. Joining the software industry has allowed me to continue my passion for knowledge and interpersonal communication while creating tools to better connect the world through technology. If you like what you see in my experience below, or just want to chat in Japanese, send me a message!

positions.title: Senior Account Manager
positions.description:
I enjoyed strengthening existing business relationships and creating new ones by actively connecting with clients. I managed and grew over 20 existing client relationships, specializing in clients with clients, for FirstNet Learning, a cloud-based software company. 

The challenge of on-boarding new clients and managing the launch of their online training programs, meeting and planning with project teams and conducting training sessions for the organization and their clients was a highlight of my day.

On a daily basis, I was responsible for was troubleshooting software with my clients. I learned the importance of asking very specific questions about the user experience to gather enough information to either resolve the issue myself or to effectively escalate it to the software development team.

positions.title: HR Services Assistant
positions.description:
I assisted the People Services team with recruitment, on-boarding, benefits enrollment, merits, employment verification, email communications, scheduling, supply orders and general teammate questions for an 800+ member market.

I also maintained the database for the HRIS and SharePoint documents including exit questionnaire reports, performance review reports and benefits information.

positions.title: Chief Native English Instructor
positions.description:
I recruited internationally, interviewed and oversaw orientation and training of three full-time employees, bringing the company's total to five and wrote, negotiated and edited their contracts.

I also created elementary school English conversation textbooks and edited English grammar textbooks to be used in-house and sold at local bookstores and Amazon Japan.

I provided outstanding customer service and English lessons to students from 18 months to 80 years of age in both private and group lesson settings.

positions.title: Prefectural Advisor & Assistant Language Teacher
positions.description:
I worked with over 80 Nagano Prefecture JET Programme participants and 120 educators from over ten countries, building their professional skills and forging connections with the community through a series of seminars and conferences as the Prefectural Advisor.

I served as the only non-Japanese member of a 10-member team to address the needs and support high school educators in Nagano Prefecture.

In addition, I provided support and disseminated accurate and pertinent information to JET Programme participants, including during the 2011 Tohoku earthquake and tsunami.

I designed and implemented English lesson plans, projects and evaluation techniques in a team-teaching environment with over 50 Japanese colleagues in prefectural high schools and municipal elementary schools including lessons to prepare students for study abroad and re-entry and initiated and implemented a 60-student exchange program with a Colorado senior high school.

educations.fieldOfStudy: History; International Studies, Latin America Concentration; Spanish Minor

volunteerExperiences.role: Crew Leader Mentor & Leadership Development Advisory Committee Member
volunteerExperiences.description: I received the Crew Leader Mentor of the Year award for 2018. I worked to provide a warm, welcoming and empowering experience to volunteers of all abilities and ages as we built and maintained trails throughout beautiful Colorado as a crew leader. I mentored aspiring crew leaders so they could hone their skills and help lead crews of volunteers on their own. As a member of the Leadership and Development Advisory Committee and the Leadership and Education sub-committee, I helped engage volunteers, recruited new crew leaders and provided them with training and mentoring opportunities to guarantee their success.

I provided crisis intervention, safety planning, and community referral services via the 24-hour crisis phone line and in person at Denver metro hospitals to survivors of sexual assault seeking information and support.

organizations.name: Japan America Society of Colorado
organizations.description:
The mission of Japan America Society of Colorado (JASC) is to expand people to people relationships between Colorado and Japan by serving as a bridge to connect via business, education and cultural opportunities.

http://www.jascolorado.org/

organizations.name: Japan Exchange and Teaching Alumni Association Rocky Mountain Chapter (JETAARM)
organizations.description:
The JET Alumni Association, Rocky Mountain chapter is an organization composed of former Japan Exchange and Teaching (JET) Program participants and was established to promote mutual understanding and international exchanges between Japan and the United States as well as to promote fellowship among alumni. 

http://jetaarockymountain.org/
